in_sanskrit.name: Vandana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who offers repeated obeisance, or one who honors a deity with flowers, garlands, and offerings.

in_marathi.name: Bandana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The Sanskrit word 'Bandana' comes from the roots 'bhand' (to bind) and 'na' (cotton). It means 'ornament' or 'turban'. In Hindu mythology, the name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity and good fortune.
